lines: Second time round, the mist laughs harder. Wait for the white flash. Don't rush.
The true letter arrived. One layer of false mist is gone.
Your eyes work better than the first time.
The letter's on you. The Trader Post at the crossroads—hand over the real one.
The mist has cleared. Your eyes… are usable.
…One more true letter. Too many fakes; the real one goes by hand.
Hit a shadow and it laughs at you. Watch the opening: the instant the blade lifts is the real one.
The Mirror Hall is east of the village. White Fog is waiting for you to get lost.
The inn first. A letter was passed all the way here. Late.
